note: SES Compatibility Corpus (ТЗ v3.2 §6.6, B25): versioned set of real pure-JS packages that must import inside the production boundary (Worker + lockdown(moderate) + one SES Compartment). Every Node/SES/endo upgrade MUST re-run this gate. `expect: pass` — the package entry must import and report module-graph-loaded. `expect: fail` — a documented incompatibility; the gate asserts the exact error code and the offending module path so unsupported packages fail at validation with a precise dependency chain, not silently at runtime.

packages.reason: Endo family: audited pure-ESM byte-to-hex helpers; exercises re-export chains inside the Compartment.
Endo family: immutable ArrayBuffer utilities; typed-array semantics under SES.
Endo family: async trampoline primitives used by hardened async code.
Endo family: dependency-version path comparison (pure string logic).

CommonJS (module.exports = ...) parses as ESM but fails at evaluation (`module` is not defined in the Compartment); vendoring path is build-time transpilation (§7.2) — recorded so the failure is a documented gate, not a silent runtime surprise.
